name: Fog Walker
shortDescription: A tall wet shape that does not keep footprints.
lookDescription: A tall wet shape of wool and peat stands in the hollow and does not keep footprints.
examineDescription: Taller than a standing badger, packed together out of wet fleece, black peat, and fog. It crosses soft ground and leaves no prints in it. The Collegium's bronze bell is somewhere inside it, and the note shifts when it moves. It will not face fewer than three Collegians. The fog thickens each time one of you commits to a move. If it goes down, the hollow smells of rain on a hot hearth-stone rather than anything sweet.
lockNarration: Fog thickens and does not keep footprints.
victoryNarration: The Fog Walker thins until the hollow smells like rain on a hearth-stone. Not sweetness. The fog is only weather again.
